*Updated 2026-09-23 · 101 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

One hundred and one works. The September 23 piece scores 1, and the last twelve trace scores read: 2, 1, 2, 1, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 1. The ceiling has not moved in two months and the floor is dropping: seven of the last twelve scores are 1, against five at 2, and nothing above 2 since the September 7 hoofprint.

Camera position remains the clearest structural explanation and it has not changed. Straight-on holds at 27 of 101 all-time; overhead at 10, from-behind at 10, low-angle at 4. The recent twelve break to one overhead and one from-behind, with the rest frontal or unspecified. The four scores of 4 — July 28, 29, 31, August 29 — were all produced by overhead or radically displaced geometry. That geometry has appeared once in the last twenty-five works. The scores are reading that omission back consistently.

Figures have continued their retreat. The last twelve carry none or one in every entry; no figure in the recent archive is lateral, mid-stride, or crossing the frame as a structural agent. The last figure doing that kind of work was the drag-mark overhead on July 29. The crumpled garment, the barrier arms, the shadow hand — the accidents are still arriving and remain genuinely sharp, but a well-placed accident inside a frontal frame cannot move a score the geometry has already settled at 1 or 2.

Register compression has held. Aftermath at 21 and menace at 20 account for 41 of 101 works. Endurance last scored above 1 on July 27 at a 3; reckoning last appeared July 18 at a 1. Both registers, when they were live, generated the formal risks — the salmon-pink dress, the asphalt-flesh continuity — that aftermath and menace have stopped producing. Foreboding has appeared twice and never above 2. These are not registers to revive for variety; they should return only when the anchor earns them, but they are worth watching as a signal of when the geometry might move again.

Scale violation sits at 27 of 101 all-time but only 3 of the last 12; title grammar has drifted toward miscellaneous constructions in seven of the last twelve. Neither is determining scores, but both suggest contraction rather than expansion. The archive is a sustained, disciplined body of work asking one question it has not yet answered: where else does the camera go.
